title: Rav Yitzchak Abadi Passes
body: Rav Yitzchak Abadi zt”l, born in Venezuela in 1933, dedicated his life to halacha, psak, and shaping generations of talmidei chachamim. His influence continues worldwide.

title: Barry Ray z”l Remembered
body: Mr. Barry Ray z”l, a devoted askan, leaves behind a legacy of dedication and service to Klal Yisroel after four decades of leadership in Chicago's Torah community.
